Nytgivelse og ny aldersgrense. Filmen skildrer en djevelutdrivelse og får 15-årsgrense pga. scener der den besatte jenta utagerer verbalt og fysisk. Virkemidlene, som var svært omdiskutert på 70-tallet, er ikke så uvanlig i film i dag.

results.overview: When a mysterious entity possesses a young girl, her mother seeks the help of two Catholic priests to save her life.
results.title: The Exorcist

results.overview: Thirteen years ago, New York City detective Julie Miller ended the terror reign of satanic serial killer Father Sunday. The case made her a hero, and she has thrown herself into her work ever since. Now a new killer scrawls her name in an altar boy's blood on the walls of a church crypt, dragging her back into the darkness she believed she had buried with him.
results.title: The Exorcist: Martyrs

results.overview: On the fifteenth anniversary of the exorcism that claimed Father Damien Karras' life, Police Lieutenant Kinderman's world is once again shattered when a boy is found decapitated and savagely crucified.
results.title: The Exorcist III

results.overview: Bizarre nightmares plague Regan MacNeil four years after her possession and exorcism. Has the demon returned? And if so, can the combined faith and knowledge of a Vatican investigator and a research specialist free her from its grasp?
results.title: Exorcist II: The Heretic

results.overview: Since his wife's death, Victor has raised his daughter Angela alone. After she and her friend return from a three-day disappearance with missing memories, they begin displaying frightening behavior reminiscent of the MacNeil possession fifty years prior.
results.title: The Exorcist: Believer

results.overview: Years before Father Merrin helped save Regan MacNeil’s soul, he first encounters the demon Pazuzu in East Africa.
results.title: Exorcist: The Beginning

results.overview: Father Gabriele Amorth, Chief Exorcist of the Vatican, investigates a young boy's terrifying possession and ends up uncovering a centuries-old conspiracy the Vatican has desperately tried to keep hidden.
results.title: The Pope's Exorcist

results.original_title: The Crucifix: Blood of the Exorcist
results.overview: A gruesome discovery in the grounds of their new home plunges a young couple into a maelstrom of spiritual possession, pagan rituals, Viking battles, and violent revenge.
results.title: The Crucifix: Blood of the Exorcist

results.overview: Who taught us that black magic is bad magic? In an experimental vertical format video, Krade explores the taboos surrounding witchcraft, the etymology of the word "necromancy", and the link between colonialism and folk magic. This short film, published in three parts,  belongs to a larger and ongoing work, including a self-published essay.
results.title: THE EXORCIST

results.overview: Ophelia, a young nun recently arriving in the town of San Ramon, is forced to perform an exorcism on a pregnant woman in danger of dying. Just when she thinks her possession has ended, she discovers that the evil presence hasn't disappeared yet. The director of the award-winning Here Comes the Devil and Late Phases adds a new twist to possession movies in one of this year's Latin American horror surprises.
results.title: The Exorcist

results.overview: Father Merrin takes a sabbatical from the Church to devote himself to history and archaeology as he struggles with his shattered faith.
results.title: Dominion: Prequel to The Exorcist

results.overview: When Joan discovers her sister has been possessed by a demonic entity, she has to enlist the help of the only remaining priest trained in exorcisms to help her overcome evil. They find themselves in a race against time to rid her sister of the demon before it can enter the world and wreak havoc.
results.title: The Last Exorcist

results.overview: The exorcist master Lin Yuanying and his apprentice Liu Yu traveled south and north to exorcise the demons and catch the demons.
results.title: The Exorcist

results.overview: A young girl and her family go through a horrifying reality while she becomes possessed by demonic forces. Throughout the film we experience the ways a family deals with situations beyond their control and how they fight to overcome them. Only when the possession takes place does the family bond get stronger and the relationships between them get tested to their limits.
results.title: Exorcist: The Fallen

results.overview: 12 year-old Gul becomes possessed by Satan after experimenting with a Ouija board. A troubled psychiatrist and an experienced exorcist become the girl’s only hope for salvation.
results.title: The Exorcist

results.overview: Twenty years after seducing a businessman, a demonic temptress lays claim to the man's daughter.
results.title: Lorna, the Exorcist

results.overview: Suave swinger and womanizer Rex Romanski loves and leaves evil black magic priestess Rita Marie. Naturally, Rex incurs Rita's lethal wrath by spurning her. Can Rex figure out a way to stop Rita's subsequent rampage of revenge, murder, and destruction as well as reclaim the soul of his new porn starlet gal-friend, Amoreena Jones, before it's too late?
results.title: The Disco Exorcist

results.overview: Follow the lives of two very different priests tackling one family’s case of terrifying demonic possession. Make-up designer, Tami Lane, talks about the process of making actors into demons.
results.title: The Exorcist: Making the Demons

results.overview: Documentary covering the famous 'demonic possession' case of Anneliese Michel. The film features authentic footage of 'exorcisms' and other shocking events, considered to be the inspiration of the film The Exorcism of Emily Rose.
results.title: Anneliese: The Exorcist Tapes

results.overview: The story of Alexios, “a pillar of his farming community, a beloved husband and father, whose mind and body are overtaken by a legion of demons. As his possession becomes more violent and fear grips the village, a young unknown preacher named Jesus comes to town with a few followers. He and only he can confront this ancient evil, which is unlike anything he has faced before — the demonic force behind the Gerasene Demoniac. What follows is the world’s original exorcism: the Miracle of the Swine, a violent and transcendent supernatural showdown whose reverberations would change the course of human history.”
results.title: The First Exorcist
